propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin per direct child and per direct prerequisite, binding the review to the narrow plan material of each target via a canonical ticket ID and 16-hex material fingerprint.

Plan material pins are encoded in the deterministic manifest after optional verified-at-sha and before dep lines in the format 'plan-material-pin: <role> <canonical-ticket-id> <material-fingerprint>', with roles sorted lexicographically (child before prerequisite) and duplicate edges within each role collapsed.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload the entire store-wide ticket state map including archived states, scan all inbound block relations to discover archived blockers, and resolve all outgoing and inbound relations before any LLM evaluation or signing.

Any unreadable, unresolvable, or malformed target reference must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with an exact enumerated reason (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure) and emit a structured ERROR log record before returning unsigned INDETERMINATE remediation, preventing partial pin sets or LLM calls.

The tracker_head_sha() function must detect dirty, unmerged, or unreadable git state using status --porcelain, ls-files -u, and rev-parse HEAD, mapping all failures to store-read-failure reason without exposing raw exceptions.

All plan-review signing paths (ordinary sign_plan_review, progressive drift refresh_attestation, and resign_plan_review) must unconditionally collect and emit the complete current pin set via collect_plan_relation_snapshot() before signing, and legacy manifest readers must authenticate the full stored DSSE manifest while ignoring additive pin lines for field interpretation.
